scheme_name: Relief under Natural Calamity / Pandemic Period (PBAOCWWB)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be registered as a Construction Worker with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The applicant must be contributing to the Board's Fund.
The applicant must not have defaulted in payment of contribution to the Board for a continuous period of more than one year.
The applicant must have been hospitalized for five or more days due to an accident or any disease.
benefits_summary: A one-time financial assistance of ₹2,000 credited via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
